Shipping & Delivery

HalloweenReady delivers Halloween costumes, decor, candy, and party supplies to all 50 United States via domestic US fulfillment. Your order ships inside America with no international customs delays.

Delivery times

  • Express: 2–3 business days express delivery to major US metros (New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, San Francisco, New Jersey)
  • Nationwide: 3–5 business days to all 50 US states
  • Dispatch: Same-day dispatch on most orders placed before daily cut-off
  • Shipping: Free shipping on selected orders

Halloween 2026 order deadlines

Halloween 2026 is Saturday, October 31, 2026. Recommended order-by dates:

WindowOrder byNotes
Ideal (stress-free)October 1 – 10, 2026Best costume selection
RecommendedOctober 15 – 20, 2026Guaranteed costume delivery

Ordering from outside the USA

Customers in India, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and worldwide can order on halloweenready.com. Enter the US delivery address at checkout — we fulfill and ship domestically within America.

Packaging

Costumes are folded and bagged with care. Decor items are packed to prevent damage in transit. Candy is sealed for freshness.
